operation.description: Finds the most stable build for the given build target. The definition of the most stable build is determined by evaluating the following rule in order until one is true. If none are true, then there is no stable build and it will return an empty response. Evaluation rules: 1. Stable channel build with label “Live” 2. Beta channel build with label “Live” 3. Dev channel build with label “Live” 4. Most recent stable channel build with build status Pass 5. Most recent beta channel build with build status Pass 6. Most recent dev channel build with build status Pass
